description: Inventory of idempotent lifecycle commands and their durable planned rows, receipt rows, crash-between-commit-and-external-action fixtures, and replay expectations.
coverage_rule: Every P083 lifecycle command in P083_COMMAND_TTL_POLICIES is listed. Commands with immediate local effects still use command_idempotency planned/outcome rows as the external-action composition boundary.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after command_idempotency acquired and provider_cancellation_intents requested, before provider cancellation dispatch

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Restart reloads requested cancellation intents and issues at most one provider cancellation per provider_session_id and cancellation_epoch.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after retry work item is committed, before scheduler claims or dispatches provider work

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Replay returns the committed retry outcome; scheduler sees one durable work item and does not enqueue a duplicate.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after stage retry work item is committed, before scheduler claims or dispatches provider work

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Replay aliases to the committed stage retry result and preserves a single retry work item for the stage_execution_id.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after approval resolution is committed, before workflow transition evaluation resumes

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Restart observes the resolved approval and performs transition evaluation once; duplicate resolve calls replay or fail terminal per policy.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after side-effect disposition is committed, before readback/projection observes the terminal state

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Replay returns the committed disposition; payload mismatch is denied and no second disposition is applied.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after shutdown_signal_side_effects rows are planned, before SIGTERM/SIGKILL dispatch

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Startup dispatches scoped planned rows once, records signal receipts, and suppresses duplicate dispatch for the same observed_generation.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after operator-verified absence is committed, before UI/readback observes identity hold resolution

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Replay returns the committed manual identity result; repeated calls do not mutate a resolved provider session twice.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after rollback audit/enforcement mode change commits, before readback exposes rollback disposition

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Replay returns the committed rollback target; enforcement mode remains at the target and no second audit transition is emitted for the same request.

crash_between_commit_and_external_action.crash_window: after enforcement mode audit commits, before rollout readback exposes the new mode

commands.replay_recovery_expectation: Replay returns the committed enforcement target; stale or mismatched requests are denied by intent hash.
